messages:
jordan: Quick pulse — milestone 'lighthouse' for Optimize toolkit this sprint. Need final owner on quant recs + batching/caching handoff. @priya @leo were last owners; can you confirm status? want a clear dep list for the release gate.

priya: I can own the quant recs, finishing the PR today. still waiting perf numbers from staging (seq=512). will post artifacts here when done.

leo: I'll take batching/caching guide + rollout script. blocking: storage blob read perf is noisy across zones, opened an infra ticket.

anna_sre: heads up — switching to continuous batching default requires a canary (10% traffic) + 5m latency SLO. i'll add a canary policy draft.

jordan: @priya @leo ack. @anna_sre can you name the canary policy and add as a draft PR? need it before merging any defaults.

anna_sre: policy name: canary/quant-optkit-10pct. added draft PR: https://git.redwood/repo/ops/pulls/478 — included smoke test steps and rollback condition.

priya: PR for quant recs: https://git.redwood/repo/optimize/pulls/234. TL;DR: 8-bit QAT for decoder-only models, -O2 kernels, kv-cache prefetch enabled. benchmarks: tokens/s ~2.2x on A100-40G. snippet: 
```
quant_profile:
  method: q8_aware
  per_channel: true
  fallback: fp16
```

leo: batching script PR: https://git.redwood/repo/optimize/pulls/235. default batch_size: 16, max_latency_ms: 120. added metric hooks for batch_effectiveness and batch_drop_rate.

jordan: Two asks before i mark milestone green:
1) @priya include a tiny regression testset in the PR (5 prompts) that validates logits difference < 1e-3
2) @leo wire up alerting for batch_drop_rate > 3% (sre/monitoring)

priya: will add regression set to PR by EOD.

leo: adding alerting now and will ping the SRE channel. ETA tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Reminder — scheduled capacity bump tomorrow 03:00 UTC for dedicated pools. No customer-impact expected.

jordan: thanks. i'll update the milestone board and ping PMs. if anything slips, drop a quick note here.

priya: done — regression tests added, see PR comment.

leo: alerting wired, created runbook entry: /runbooks/optkit-batch-failure.

anna_sre: canary live, 10% traffic. 30m check: latency and error rates within thresholds, no anomalies.

jordan: closing loop — marking milestone as pre-release. final signoffs pending but looking good :white_check_mark:
